content.text:
I added `GET /api/messages/{id}` in `src/app/api/messages/[id]/route.ts`. It uses a new `getForRecipient` query in `src/repos/messages.ts` that matches on both message id and recipient and selects only the columns it needs. Anyone who isn't the recipient (other users, admins, other practices) or any unknown id gets a 404 `not_found`, and unauthenticated requests get 401. The recipient gets exactly `{id, subject, body, sentAt, from:{name}}`, and the message is marked read and audited with ids only. `npm run verify` passes, including four new tests in `tests/message-read.test.ts`.

Data decisions I settled: non-recipients and missing ids return the same 404, and nothing besides the allowed fields is returned, cached or logged.
